content:
"Patrimoria" suggests wealth management, but the page offers automated share trading with no licence or company. It makes "huge profit" style claims without evidence. Outside verification was not run.

What the page says

  • Platform type: online trading platform
  • Technology: AI technology
  • Minimum deposit: min $250
  • Asset class: shares
  • Payment methods: credit cards
  • Withdrawal: withdrawal within 24h
  • Registration fee: no registration fee
  • Support: round-the-clock support

What we could not check

We have not run regulator or security-database checks on this platform for this review. The page does not name a regulator, licence or company.
